dataset: Columbia Image Splicing Detection Evaluation Dataset (2004 image-block set)
task: binary image-block classification: authentic vs spliced
features: fixed handcrafted grayscale histogram, moments, and horizontal/vertical gradient statistics
classifier: L2-regularized logistic regression implemented with NumPy full-batch gradient descent
threshold_selection: maximize Youden J on dev set; tie-break at threshold closest to 0.5
warning: Patch-level pipeline sanity check only. Not a full-image detection or localization result. Split groups identical SHA-256 duplicates only; original parent-image IDs are unavailable, so source-scene isolation is not established.
